lines.why_did_the_creeper_get: Why did the creeper get invited everywhere? It always had a blast.
lines.what_do_you_call_a: What do you call a pig that does karate? A pork chop.
lines.why_dont_skeletons_fight_each: Why don't skeletons fight each other? They don't have the guts.
lines.i_tried_farming_once_it: I tried farming once. It didn't grow on me.
lines.the_miller_asked_if_i: The miller asked if I wanted to go halves on bread. I said I knead the money.
lines.why_was_the_chicken_so: Why was the chicken so good at the market? It knew how to egg people on.
lines.what_did_the_zombie_order: What did the zombie order at the inn? The waiter.

lines.why_dont_spiders_get_lost: Why don't spiders get lost? They always use the web.

lines.what_do_you_call_a_2: What do you call a sheep with no legs? A cloud.
lines.why_did_the_enderman_cross: Why did the enderman cross the road? He didn't. He teleported.
lines.whats_a_creepers_favourite_food: What's a creeper's favourite food? Ssssssalad.
lines.why_did_the_cow_look: Why did the cow look at the sky all night? She wanted to see the moooon.
lines.why_did_the_villager_bring: Why did the villager bring a ladder to the market? Prices were going up.
lines.why_did_the_miner_go: Why did the miner go broke? He hit rock bottom.
lines.why_cant_you_trust_stairs: Why can't you trust stairs? They're always up to something.
lines.what_do_you_call_a_3: What do you call a fish with no eyes? A fsh.
lines.why_do_trees_hate_tests: Why do trees hate tests? They get stumped.
lines.why_did_the_baker_stop: Why did the baker stop making donuts? He got tired of the hole thing.
lines.what_do_you_call_a_4: What do you call a bee that can't make up its mind? A maybe.
lines.why_did_the_scarecrow_win: Why did the scarecrow win an award? He was outstanding in his field.
lines.why_dont_eggs_tell_jokes: Why don't eggs tell jokes? They'd crack each other up.
lines.what_did_the_ocean_say: What did the ocean say to the beach? Nothing. It just waved.
lines.why_do_squids_never_fight: Why do squids never fight? They'd rather ink it over.
lines.what_do_skeletons_say_before: What do skeletons say before dinner? Bone appetit.
lines.why_did_the_zombie_stay: Why did the zombie stay home? He was feeling rotten.
lines.what_do_you_call_a_5: What do you call a dog that does magic? A labracadabrador.
lines.why_did_the_chicken_join: Why did the chicken join the band? It had the drumsticks.
lines.why_did_the_torch_go: Why did the torch go to school? To get a little brighter.
lines.why_did_the_horse_keep: Why did the horse keep falling over? It wasn't stable.
lines.what_did_the_pig_say: What did the pig say on a hot day? I'm bacon out here.
lines.whats_a_bats_favourite_sport: What's a bat's favourite sport? Batminton.
lines.why_is_the_slime_good: Why is the slime good at parties? It always bounces back.
lines.why_did_the_cake_go: Why did the cake go to the doctor? It was feeling crummy.
lines.what_do_you_call_a_6: What do you call a sleeping bull? A bulldozer.
lines.why_did_the_frog_take: Why did the frog take the boat? His cart got toad.
lines.why_do_bees_have_sticky: Why do bees have sticky hair? They use honeycombs.
lines.whats_the_smiths_favourite_music: What's the smith's favourite music? Heavy metal.
lines.why_did_the_anvil_feel: Why did the anvil feel sad? Everyone kept dropping it on things.
lines.what_do_you_call_a_7: What do you call a cow with no legs? Ground beef.
lines.why_did_the_librarian_leave: Why did the librarian leave? Too many plot twists.
lines.i_told_the_smith_a: I told the smith a joke. He didn't laugh. Tough crowd, iron people.
lines.why_was_the_ghast_so: Why was the ghast so sad? It never stopped crying.
lines.what_kind_of_music_do: What kind of music do mummies like? Wrap. Wait, we don't have mummies. Husks, then. Husk-hop.
lines.why_did_the_farmer_plant: Why did the farmer plant a lantern? He wanted a bright future.
lines.whats_a_parrots_favourite_game: What's a parrot's favourite game? Hide and speak.
lines.why_did_the_golem_go: Why did the golem go to the doctor? It had iron deficiency. Wait, no, the opposite.
lines.what_do_you_call_a_8: What do you call a lazy kangaroo? A pouch potato. I don't know what a kangaroo is either.
lines.why_did_the_guard_bring: Why did the guard bring string to work? To tie up loose ends.
